description: AAASM-5353 / AAASM-5345: the same synthetic national ID written in full-width digits, one keystroke away on any CJK input method and unchanged through JSON. Offsets are in bytes of the ORIGINAL text, so each full-width digit occupies three bytes, not one - a span computed over normalised digits would index the wrong bytes and make redaction fail closed.
